title: GlobalQuran Developers: Quran API, data, audio and embed
description: Free Quran API, a ready-made reader to embed on your website or app, downloadable text and translations, audio, fonts and PDF. No ads, no tracking.

title: Free Quran API: JSON for every ayah, surah, page and juz
description: Get a free API key and read the Quran as JSON with the translation you choose. Works for websites, mobile apps and servers.

title: Quran API reference: every endpoint
description: All GlobalQuran API endpoints in one simple list: lists, reading by ayah, surah, page or juz, complete text and audio. Try each with Run.

description: Add a full Quran reader with audio and translations to your site or app with two lines of HTML. Pick the options and copy the code.

title: Download Quran data: text and translations
description: Download the Quran text and translations in many languages as TXT or JSON, one at a time or as a ZIP.

title: Quran audio: reciters and file addresses
description: Browse reciters, hear a sample, and build direct audio file addresses from our CDN for your own player.

title: Quran fonts, mushaf pages and ayah images
description: Try Arabic Quran fonts, see mushaf pages with tajweed colours, and download fonts and ayah images, free to use.

title: Quran PDF: preview, then download
description: Choose what goes in, preview the pages, then download the Quran as a PDF or print it. Free, no sign-in.

title: Donate: keep the Quran free for everyone
description: GlobalQuran is free, with no ads. Donations pay for servers, audio hosting and new tools to help people read and memorise the Quran.

title: About GlobalQuran: free Quran platform since 2006
description: The story, beliefs and people behind GlobalQuran, a free Quran platform with an open API since 2006.

title: Contact GlobalQuran
description: Questions about the API, a bug, a translation or a partnership? Send us a message.

description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client to the Quran: Arabic text, 95 translations, tafsir and audio links. Free, read-only, no sign-in.
